results.summary:
**Root cause:** In `handle()` (main/main.c), only `key` was checked for `NULL` after parsing a `set` command with `strtok`. When the operator omitted the value (e.g. `set name`), `value` was `NULL`, and `apply_setting()` passed it straight to `strncpy(cfg->name, value, ...)` / `atoi(value)`, dereferencing a null pointer and crashing/rebooting the device.

**Fix:** Extended the existing guard to also check `value == NULL`, printing `error: usage: set <key> <value>` and returning before `apply_setting()` is ever called — one line changed in `main/main.c:40`.

Verified in QEMU: `set name` now pri
